title: 古意呈补阙乔知之
title_en: An Old-Style Theme, Presented to Censor Qiao Zhizhi
author: 沈佺期

readings.zh: “少妇”是年轻的妻子，“少”读 shào，不读 shǎo。
readings.en: Here the word means a young wife, so the character is read shào, not shǎo.

readings.zh: “海燕”是燕子，“燕”读 yàn。读 yān 时指地名。
readings.en: Here the character means the swallow, so it is read yàn. Read yān, it is a place name.

readings.zh: “秋夜长”的“长”是长短的长，读 cháng，不读 zhǎng。
readings.en: Here the character means long, so it is read cháng, not zhǎng.

readings.zh: “更教”是“又让”的意思，“教”现在读 jiào。古时这个意思也读平声 jiāo。
readings.en: Here the character means to make or let, and is read jiào today. In older usage this sense was also read with a level tone, jiāo.

glosses.zh: 卢家少妇：古乐府里说，有个叫莫愁的女子十五岁嫁到卢家。这里借指一位年轻的妻子。
glosses.en: lú jiā shào fù: an old folk song tells of a girl named Mochou who married into the Lu family at fifteen. Here it means a young wife.

glosses.zh: 郁金堂：用郁金香料和泥涂墙的房子，又香又华美。
glosses.en: yù jīn táng: a room whose walls were plastered with mud mixed with fragrant turmeric, scented and fine.

glosses.zh: 海燕：燕子。古人以为燕子从海上飞来，所以叫海燕。
glosses.en: hǎi yàn: swallows. People in the past thought swallows came from across the sea.

glosses.zh: 双栖：成双成对地住在一起。
glosses.en: shuāng qī: to nest together as a pair.

glosses.zh: 玳瑁梁：用玳瑁装饰的屋梁。玳瑁是一种海龟，壳很漂亮，可以做装饰。
glosses.en: dài mào liáng: a roof beam decorated with tortoiseshell. The hawksbill turtle has a beautiful shell used for decoration.

glosses.zh: 寒砧：秋天的捣衣声。砧，捶打衣服用的石头。
glosses.en: hán zhēn: the cold sound of cloth being pounded in autumn. Zhēn is the stone block on which cloth was beaten.

glosses.zh: 催木叶：好像在催树叶快快落下。
glosses.en: cuī mù yè: as if hurrying the leaves to fall.

glosses.zh: 征戍：出征打仗，守卫边疆。
glosses.en: zhēng shù: to go off to war and guard the border.

glosses.zh: 辽阳：地名，在今天辽宁一带，唐代是东北边防要地。
glosses.en: Liáoyáng: a place in today's Liaoning, a key border post in the northeast in Tang times.

glosses.zh: 白狼河北：白狼河的北边。白狼河就是今天辽宁的大凌河。
glosses.en: bái láng hé běi: north of the White Wolf River, today's Daling River in Liaoning.
dān fèng chéng: the Red Phoenix City, meaning the capital, Chang'an.

glosses.zh: 谁谓：谁说。有的本子作“谁为”，意思是“为了谁”。
glosses.en: shuí wèi: who says. Some editions have a different second character, giving for whose sake.

glosses.zh: 独不见：古乐府的一个曲名，内容多写思念而见不到人。这里也说她独自一人，见不到丈夫。
glosses.en: dú bù jiàn: Alone and Not Seeing, the name of an old folk song tune about longing for someone you cannot see. Here it also means she is alone and cannot see her husband.
gèng: on top of that, even.

glosses.zh: 流黄：黄褐色的丝绢，这里指用它做的帷帐。
glosses.en: liú huáng: yellow-brown silk; here, the bed curtains made of it.

translation.zh: 卢家年轻的妻子，住在香气四溢的郁金堂里，
translation.en: The young wife of the Lu family lives in a room scented with turmeric;

translation.zh: 燕子成双成对地住在玳瑁装饰的屋梁上。
translation.en: swallows nest in pairs on the tortoiseshell beams.

translation.zh: 九月里捣衣声一阵阵，好像在催树叶落下，
translation.en: In the ninth month the cold pounding of cloth seems to hurry the leaves down;

translation.zh: 丈夫守边十年了，她天天想念辽阳。
translation.en: her husband has guarded the border ten years, and she thinks of Liaoyang every day.

translation.zh: 白狼河北边，一点消息也没有，
translation.en: From north of the White Wolf River no letters come;

translation.zh: 长安城南，秋天的夜晚格外漫长。
translation.en: south of the capital, the autumn night is long.

translation.zh: 谁说她满怀忧愁，独自见不到心上人？
translation.en: Who says she is full of sorrow, alone and unable to see him?

translation.zh: 偏偏还让明月照着她的黄绢帷帐。
translation.en: On top of that, the bright moon shines on her yellow silk curtains.

background.zh: 乔知之是沈佺期的朋友，当时做补阙，一种负责给皇帝提意见的官。“古意”是说借古乐府的题材来写诗，这首诗就是仿照乐府旧题《独不见》写的。诗里写一位丈夫远在东北边疆的妻子，在秋夜里的思念。写作的具体时间不能确定。
background.en: Qiao Zhizhi was Shen Quanqi's friend and served as a remonstrance official, whose job was to point out the emperor's mistakes. Gǔ yì, an old-style theme, means the poem borrows a subject from old folk songs; it follows the old song title Alone and Not Seeing. It describes a wife whose husband is far away on the northeastern border, longing for him on an autumn night. We do not know exactly when it was written.

author_note.zh: 沈佺期（约656—约715），初唐诗人。他和宋之问都很讲究格律，让律诗的规则定型下来，两人合称“沈宋”。这首诗是早期七言律诗里很有名的一首，后人评价很高。
author_note.en: Shen Quanqi (about 656 to about 715) was an early Tang poet. He and Song Zhiwen paid close attention to tone and rhyme rules and helped fix the form of regulated verse; the two are called Shen and Song. This poem is one of the best-known early seven-character regulated poems and has been highly praised.

appreciation.zh: 开头是一幅华美的画：香气四溢的房间，雕饰精美的屋梁，梁上的燕子成双成对。房子再好，女主人却孤零零一个人，连燕子都比她幸福。接着声音进来了：九月的捣衣声，好像在催树叶落下，也在催她想起远方的丈夫，一想就是十年。第五、六句一北一南：丈夫在白狼河北，没有消息；她在长安城南，秋夜漫长。两个地方，一份思念。最后她心里已经够苦了，月亮偏偏还要照进她的帷帐，让她更睡不着。全诗没有一个“哭”字，却句句是愁。
appreciation.en: It opens with a rich picture: a fragrant room, finely carved beams, and swallows nesting in pairs. The house is lovely, but its mistress is all alone; even the swallows are happier than she is. Then sound comes in. The pounding of cloth in the ninth month seems to hurry the leaves to fall, and it hurries her thoughts to her husband far away, ten years gone. Lines five and six set north against south. He is north of the White Wolf River, with no news; she is south of the capital, in a long autumn night. Two places, one longing. At the end her heart already aches, and still the moon shines into her curtains and keeps her awake. The poem never says she cries, yet every line is full of sorrow.
